newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan 91-day T-bills average yield at 5.845 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan 91-day T-bills average yield at 5.845 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's finance ministry issued T$15 billion in 91-day treasury bills on Tuesday at an average yield of 5.845 percent, a ministry official said.
The range of the bids was between 5.55 and 5.95 percent.
The central bank completed the auction of the bills on behalf of the finance ministry, the official said.
The formal issue date is Wednesday.
The central bank's last issue took place in October 1996, with the total amount also T$15 billion.
